Set.Author: Nikola Hristov
Set.Message:
refactor(Rest): Migrate to OXC 0.127 API for codegen and transform

Update Rest to work with OXC 0.127's restructured APIs. The old flat `comments: bool` in CodegenOptions is replaced by a structured CommentOptions type supporting separate control over normal, jsdoc, annotation, and legal comments. Map legacy boolean to the two extremes for backward compatibility.

For transformer, replace the deprecated `into_symbol_table_and_scope_tree()` / `build_with_symbols_and_scopes()` (OXC 0.48-era API) with the new unified `into_scoping()` / `build_with_scoping()` which returns a single Scoping value.

The binary is regenerated to include these changes.
